name: OW3P1-leader-bare-interrupt
note: AUDIT OW3 P1: a member's stop interrupts the leader and leaves the panel up - the leader frozen, still 'journeying', the halt never reaching the party.

name: OW3P1-member-bare-interrupt
note: AUDIT OW3 P1: a member halted by the party keeps the panel up, counts as journeying, and is never set out again.

name: OW3P1-panel-is-journeying
note: AUDIT OW3 P1: a journey stopped under a panel left up (a window over it, the Overworld brought down) reads as walking.

name: OW3P1-halt-late
old: if (leaderMustHalt(tw, stops, now)) return { tw: { ...tw, h: Math.round(now) }, halt: true };
new: if (leaderMustHalt(tw, stops, now)) return { tw, halt: true };
note: AUDIT OW3 P1: the leader stops on a member's stop but the walk is not halted with it.

name: OW3P1-halt-unsaid
note: AUDIT OW3 P1: the walk halts on a member's stop but the leader's own journey walks on.

name: OW3P2-begin-keeps-old
note: AUDIT OW3 P2: a journey begun with nobody gathered (or no longer the leader) leaves the old walk riding the pose.

name: OW3P2-begin-carries-old
old: if (live && sameWalkDest(live, { x: dest.pixel.x, y: dest.pixel.y, spot: !!dest.point })) {
note: AUDIT OW3 P2: any journey after a halted walk sets the OLD walk out again - the members start for the old place.

name: OW3P2-elsewhere-sets-out
old: if (journeying) return { tw: mine ? { ...tw, go: Math.round(now), h: null } : null, halt: false };
new: if (journeying) return { tw: { ...tw, go: Math.round(now), h: null }, halt: false };
note: AUDIT OW3 P2: the leader's next journey of any kind sets a halted walk out again - toward the old destination.

name: OW3P2-forgotten-stays
old: if (dest ? !mine : tw.sx == null) return { tw: null, halt: false };
new: if (false) return { tw: null, halt: false };
note: AUDIT OW3 P2: a halted place walk with nothing left to resume stays halted - its members held for ever.

name: OW3P2-elsewhere-walks-on
old: if (!mine) return { tw: null, halt: false };
note: A leader who takes a journey of another place keeps the walk - the members walk on to where the leader is not going.

name: OW3P3-yes-outlives-walk
old: return tw && mine && mine.at === tw.at ? mine : NO_WALK_ANSWER;
note: AUDIT OW3 P3: a member's yes outlives its walk - their next journey of their own is stopped, their stops halt walks they never joined.

name: OW3P3-follows-any-round
old: return !!tw && !!mine && mine.at === tw.at && mine.yes && mine.go != null;
note: AUDIT OW3 P3: a member counts as following a round they never answered.

name: OW3P3-host-keeps-yes
note: AUDIT OW3 P3: the host never lets a stale yes go.

name: OW3P3-leave-never
note: A member who walks off somewhere else stays in the walk - their stops halt it, and the next set-out drags them back.

name: OW3P4-asked-over-a-window
note: AUDIT OW3 P4: the question comes up over whatever the member has open, in a fight, in a duel.

name: OW3P4-box-replaces
note: AUDIT OW3 P4: the question replaces (and disposes) an open window that does not pause.

name: OW3P4-box-never-down
old: if (_walkBox && !walkAskStands({ tw, round: _walkBoxRound, now, danger: walkDanger() })) walkBoxDown();
note: AUDIT OW3 P4: the question stays up after its round ended, the party dissolved, a new round began or its asking passed.

name: OW3P4-box-lost
note: AUDIT OW3 P4: a question another window replaced is still 'up' - the member is never asked again this session.

name: OW3P4-box-in-danger
note: AUDIT OW3 P4: the question stands while a foe closes in or a duel begins.

name: OW3P4-box-other-round
note: AUDIT OW3 P4: the question of an old round answers a new one.

name: OW3P5-ends-uncounted
old: st.cleared++;   // AUDIT OW3 P5: the journey's end, counted
note: AUDIT OW3 P5: Travel Options never says a journey ENDED - an arrival reads as a stop.

name: OW3P5-spot-stop-ends
old: if (!tw || ended) return { tw: null, halt: false };
new: if (!tw || ended || !dest) return { tw: null, halt: false };
note: AUDIT OW3 P5: a spot walk's stop (its route nulled) is read, by the destination fields, as the walk's end - the party walks on.

name: OW3P5-host-never-ended
note: AUDIT OW3 P5: the host never reads an end - an arrival halts the party, a forgotten walk stays.

name: OW3P3-released-stop-said
note: AUDIT OW3 P3: a member released (the walk gone, a new round) in the breath their journey stopped still halts the leader's walk.

name: OW3P6-no-journeys-asked
note: A member with Travel Options off is asked, says yes, and the start throws on the null mod.

name: OW3P6-start-anyway
note: AUDIT OW3 P6: a set-out starts the member's journey in a dungeon, under the death screen, mid-fight, over a window.

name: OW3P6-dead-walks
note: AUDIT OW3 P6: a dead member is set out with the party, a journey under the death screen.

name: OW3P6-underground-walks
note: AUDIT OW3 P6: a member in a dungeon or a building is set out (the panel force-closed) or asked.

name: OW3P7-no-grace
old: return h.tw && now - h.at <= PARTY_WALK_GRACE_MS ? h : { acct, tw: null, at: h.at };
new: return { acct, tw: null, at: h.at };
note: AUDIT OW3 P7: a moment without the leader's pose (a reconnect) drops every member out of the walk.

name: OW3P7-grace-forever
old: return h.tw && now - h.at <= PARTY_WALK_GRACE_MS ? h
note: AUDIT OW3 P7: a leader gone for good still walks the party.

name: OW3P7-heard-from-anyone
old: const h = held && held.acct === acct ? held : { acct, tw: null, at: -Infinity };
new: const h = held ?? { acct, tw: null, at: -Infinity };
note: AUDIT OW3 P7: a new leader with no pose yet is believed to walk the old leader's walk.

name: OW3P7-host-always-present
old: present: memberPresent(leadRow), tw: leadRow?.p?.tw ?? null }, nowMs);
new: present: true, tw: leadRow?.p?.tw ?? null }, nowMs);
note: AUDIT OW3 P7: the host reads 'no pose' as 'no walk'.

name: OW3P9-resume-new-round
old: const w = { ...live, go: Math.round(now), h: null };
note: AUDIT OW3 P9: the halted walk taken up again from the Overworld's flag is a NEW round - members who stopped over 60 m off are dropped.

name: OW3P9-walking-set-out
note: AUDIT OW3 P9: the flag clicked while the party walks counts as a set-out.

name: OW3P9-spot-point-stale
old:
if (dest.point) { w.sx = Math.round(dest.point.x); w.sz = Math.round(dest.point.z); }
    return w;
note: AUDIT OW3 P9: a spot walk set out again sends the members to the old point, the leader to the new.

name: OW3P10-asked-past-asking
old: return !!tw && tw.at === round && now - tw.at <= PARTY_WALK_ASK_MS && !danger;
note: AUDIT OW3 P10: the question stays up past its asking - the member is never left behind.
